title: Retrospective pre-movement left-choice probability from brain-wide spikes
disposition_reason: The retained manifest describes a verified exposed one-session 93-query programme; its authoring bridge is a historical locator. The public full 29-session process source supplies real probability scoring and F/I boundaries but explicitly lacks an authentic structured-input extractor, admitted deployment and scientific qualification. Neither scope is an untouched held-animal causal test.

scientific_target.question: Within separately calibrated sessions, does neural activity in the one second before the known movement onset improve left-choice probabilities beyond signed stimulus and lawful preceding-trial history, with block-prior context tested separately?
scientific_target.known_answer: Binary recorded choice: right=0 and left=1; candidate returns P(left). No-response trials and source-invalid trials retain explicit source dispositions.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Original behavior choice field aligned to source-valid trial chronology; held query choice is private during collection and reconstructed by the independent evaluator.
scientific_target.case_unit: An eligible original trial with complete [movement_onset-1 second, movement_onset) spike support.
scientific_target.independent_unit: 13 animals across 29 sessions and seven laboratories in the complete design; the exposed historical 93-query route is one mouse/session.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective movement-aligned association with within-session train/validation calibration. Knowing movement onset and, in SBH/SBHN, block prior is privileged context; the design is not real-time onset prediction, unseen-animal learning or causal evidence.
exclusions: Do not pool the one-session exposed route with the 29-session design as independent replication.
Do not call F/I a pure reasoning contrast or treat source-only transport as a model trial.
Do not read current outcomes, future trials or query labels through history.

inputs: S: nine signed-contrast indicators; H: seven lawful original-predecessor/history indicators; optional B: three block-prior indicators.
N: all native units' spike counts during [movement_onset-1 second, movement_onset); condition arms are SH, SHN, SBH and SBHN.
Labeled same-session training and validation views; query inputs arrive under committed source/config/state artifacts.
forbidden_inputs: Current choice, current reward/feedback, post-cutoff spikes, future-trial history, raw target-bearing HDF5 behavior groups and original target joins.
Inferring previous trial from the previous retained eligible row when an excluded original trial intervenes.
Cross-session/condition candidate state and target/evaluator feedback.
observation_contract.case_identity: Full preparer computes case_ plus SHA256 of session_id, source identity and original ordinal. It preserves every original trial slot, sorted-to-raw mapping and predecessor relation; original session/animal/lab roster is fixed. No authentic full-cohort case manifest was produced here.
observation_contract.split: Complete source uses each session's verified original TS1 train/validation/test domains, whole pre-movement-window containment and chronology. F source is frozen globally, but fitting is within session. The historical exposed route contains 211 training, 60 validation and 93 sequential query cases from 424 original slots.
observation_contract.coverage: Full design requires all 29 sessions, 13 animals, seven labs and all eligible original trials; exact full counts are unresolved. Four information conditions and F/I arms are nested conditions. Historical 93-query software-route evidence remains separately scoped.

primary.name: Animal-macro left-choice log loss
primary.aggregation: Pool required held trials across sessions within each animal, calculate mean log loss, then equal-weight all 13 animals; the historical single-session route reports its own 93-query mean.
primary.rationale: A proper probability score rewards calibrated known-choice inference; balanced accuracy alone loses confidence information.

secondary: Brier score, balanced accuracy at p_left>=0.5, tie-correct AUC and class/support counts.
Paired SH versus SHN and SBH versus SBHN neural gains; SH versus SBH privileged-context gains.
Per-session and pooled-trial diagnostics, leave-one-animal and leave-one-lab summaries.

comparators.name: Shared fitted class prior
comparators.procedure: Use identical prior fitting identity across the four information conditions; preserve its complete query predictions.

comparators.name: L regularized logistic and H histogram-gradient-boosting references
comparators.procedure: Freeze source grids, fit preprocessing on train only, select on validation and retain original full refit policy; native competence remains unqualified.

comparators.name: Reference label/neural diagnostics
comparators.inputs: Fixed reference data and already selected method families.
comparators.procedure: 20 D-label and 20 D-neural panels are association stress diagnostics; they cannot select primary methods or become null-distribution p-values.

nuisance_controls: Movement-onset alignment is an explicit retrospective privilege.
Block-prior access is isolated as B; do not credit its information to spikes.
History follows original trial chronology and availability, including source-excluded predecessors.
All four information conditions use exact same held-trial support and correct condition-specific feature schema.
evaluation.uncertainty: Retain all 13 paired animal effects and seven-lab dependence. Source uses 1,999 deterministic animal resamples, explicitly an unqualified conditional spread without refitting or exchangeability assurance; no binary success/p-value claim follows.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require one finite [0,1] probability and exact session/case/ordinal/unit/config/state identity for every expected held trial. Missing or duplicate rows, failed commitments and invalid probabilities make the complete session/animal endpoint unavailable; supported subsets remain descriptive only. One-class BA/AUC is undefined, not zero.

implementation.scorer_target: Independent evaluation.py recomputes log loss (clipped at 1e-12 only for logarithms), Brier, confusion-derived balanced accuracy and exact-tie AUC from captured binary choice/probability pairs; complete animal macro requires all 13 animals. This is genuine behavioral target prediction, not reproducing paper values.
implementation.delivered_scope: The public complete-process package implements source-level preparation, references, captured fit/predict interfaces and protected scoring. Its README declares all authentic gates unpassed; the older manifest's passed software route covers only the exposed 93-query single session.
missing: Authentic full original-to-structured extractor and verification of all 29 recordings.
Qualified Linux/Docker/native reference/model environment and external supervisor.
Fresh complete F/I collection with equal ceilings and protected targets; no such model run was made.
implementation.execution_evidence: Source inspection in this revision only; no authentic-data preparation, candidate execution or model trial was performed.

direct_observation.representation: Prospective probability response from the same fixed count/context vector without code or external model tools.
direct_observation.boundary: Hold case observations, demonstrations and sequential history policy fixed; hide current choice and future cases.
missing: No direct no-tools participant transport or full support response collection.

typed_viewer.representation: Prospective spike raster/count plot with signed-stimulus/history context and captured P(left).
typed_viewer.boundary: Typed rendering and navigation only; target fields and raw array/tool execution unavailable.
missing: No rendered participant interface or image-equivalence control.

tool_assisted.representation: Full I policy fits on allowed calibration and can produce a session-specific committed predictor; source supports a bounded model tool.
tool_assisted.boundary: Same session and information condition; fresh predict process for each query; no protected targets or cross-case model conversation state.
missing: Authentic extractor, selected compatible model/runtime and qualified full process execution.

frozen_program.representation: Full F source is captured before authentic input opening, fitted per session and retained unchanged as source with committed config/state.
frozen_program.boundary: Training/validation only for fitting; query probability committed before protected grading. Historical prefix-adaptive single-session route remains explicitly different.
missing: Full-cohort data and native execution qualification; historical bridge locator must not be mistaken for a current public turnkey route.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: Manifest preserves a passed local 93-query programme-route control on one exposed mouse/session, not an LLM campaign result. Public full-process source remains inactive and unqualified; this revision ran no model.
excluded_claims: Within-session calibration is not held-animal predictive generalization.
Pre-movement alignment does not imply an online endpoint when the cutoff uses future-known movement onset.

summary: Correct the endpoint to retrospective left-choice probability with explicit privileged alignment/block context.
Distinguish exposed 93-query history from the full 29-session source design.
Make log loss primary and require complete matched animal support with original-predecessor history.
